def load():
    import os,glob,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

from collections import deque
def bspf(a):
    s=segs_of(a)

from collections import deque
def f(g, order=None):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    A=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==2]
    B=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==3]
    ae=min((min(abs(r-rr)+abs(c-cc) for rr,cc in B),(r,c)) for (r,c) in A)[1]
    be=min((min(abs(r-rr)+abs(c-cc) for rr,cc in A),(r,c)) for (r,c) in B)[1]
    moves=order or [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]
    seen={ae}; par={ae:None}; q=deque([ae]); found=False
    while q and not found:
        cur=q.popleft()
        if cur==be: found=True; break
        r,c=cur
        for dr,dc in moves:
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and (nr,nc) not in seen and g[nr][nc] not in (2,3):
                seen.add((nr,nc)); par[(nr,nc)]=cur; q.append((nr,nc))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if found and be in seen:
        cur=be
        while cur is not None:
            out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
            cur=par[cur]
    return out

def seg_of(gi,mk):

    rs={i for i,_ in pts}; cs={j for _,j in pts}

                    run2.append(n); c2=n
                    if c2==b: hit=True
                if not hit: continue
                cand=run+run2
                if best is None or len(cand)>len(best): best=cand[:]

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(gi):
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v not in (2,3)),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    oA,pA=segs(gi,2); oB,pB=segs(gi,3)
    def ok(i,j): return 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and gi[i][j]==bg
    def ends(ps,ax):
        if ax=='V': return [(min(p[0] for p in ps),(max(p[0] for p in ps))) for _ in [0]]
        return []
    # candidate corridors: start at A endpoint, walk straight outward until blocked or chosen stop, then perpendicular straight run toward B until adjacency
    best=None
    if oA=='V':
        top=min(p[0] for p in pA); bot=max(p[0] for p in pA)
        for s,d in ((top,(1,0)),(bot,(-1,0))):
            cur=s; tot=[]; 
            # step 1: walk straight until we decide to stop (anywhere)
            while True:
                nxt=(cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1])
                if not ok(*nxt): break
                cur=nxt; tot.append(cur)
                if any(abs(cur[0]-b[0])+abs(cur[1]-b[1])==1 for b in pB):
                    # reached adjacency without turning
                    cand=tot; 
                    if best is None or len(cand)>len(best): best=cand
                    break
            if cur==s: continue
            # turn perpendicular toward B's column/row: two options
            for nd in ((0,1),(0,-1)):
                tgt=[b for b in pB if b[1]==cur[1]]
                if not tgt: continue
                t=bmin=min(tgt,key=lambda b:abs(b[0]-cur[0]))
                conn=[]
                r=cur[0]
                step=(1,0) if t[0]>r else (-1,0)
                while (r+step[0],cur[1])!=(t[0],t[1]):
                    r+=step[0]; conn.append((r,cur[1]))
                if all(ok(*c) for c in conn):
                    full=tot+conn
                    if best is None or len(full)>len(best): best=full
                if nd==(0,-1):
                    tgt=[b for b in pB if b[1]==cur[1]]
                    if not tgt: continue
                    t=bmin=min(tgt,key=lambda b:abs(b[0]-cur[0]))
                    r=cur[0]
                    step=(-1,0) if t[0]<r else (1,0)
                    while (r+step[0],cur[1])!=(t[0],t[1]):
                        r+=step[0]; conn.append((r,cur[1]))
                    if all(ok(*c) for c in conn):
                        full=tot+conn
                        if best is None or len(full)>len(best): best=full
    else:
        left=min(p[1] for p in pA); right=max(p[1] for p in pA)
        for s,d in ((left,(0,1)),(right,(0,-1))):
            cur=s; tot=[]
            while True:
                nxt=(cur[0],cur[1]+d[1])
                if not ok(*nxt): break
                cur=nxt; tot.append(cur)
                if any(abs(cur[0]-b[0])+abs(cur[1]-b[1])==1 for b in pB):
                    cand=tot
                    if best is None or len(cand)>len(best): best=cand
                    break
            if cur==s: continue
            for nd in ((1,0),(-1,0)):
                tgt=[b for b in pB if b[0]==cur[0]]
                if not tgt: continue
                t=min(tgt,key=lambda b:abs(b[1]-cur[1]))
                conn=[]
                c=cur[1]
                step=(0,1) if t[1]>c else (0,-1)
                while (cur[0],c+step[1])!=(t[0],t[1]):
                    c+=step[1]; conn.append((cur[0],c))
                if all(ok(*c2) for c2 in conn):
                    full=tot+conn
                    if best is None or len(full)>len(best): best=full
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for (i,j) in (best or []): out[i][j]=3
    return out

allm=True
for k in sorted(G):
    if k.startswith('Demo'):
        pred=solve(G[k]); act=G[k.replace(' input',' output')]
        dif=[(i,j) for i in range(len(pred)) for j in range(len(pred[0])) if pred[i][j]!=act[i][j]]
        allm&=not dif
        print(k,'match:',not dif,'ndiff',len(dif),dif[:5])
print('ALL DEMOS MATCH:',allm)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(gi):
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v not in (2,3)),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    def segs_of(mk):
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mk]
        vert=len({j for _,j in pts})==1
        return vert,pts
    avert,Apt=segs_of(2)
    bvert,Bpt=segs_of(3)
    def ok(i,j): return 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and gi[i][j]==bg
    def adj(pts,p): return any(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1])==1 for q in pts)
    best=None
    def dfs(cur,d_dir,runs,path):
        nonlocal best
        if runs>=4: return
        p=path[-1]
        if adj(Bpt,p):
            painted=sum(1 for c in path if c not in set(Apt)|set(Bpt))
            if best is None or painted>best[0]: best=(painted,list(path))
            return
        nxt=(cur[0]+d_dir[0],cur[1]+d_dir[1])
        if ok(nxt[0],nxt[1]): dfs(nxt,d_dir,runs+1,path+[nxt])
        for nd in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
            if nd==(-d_dir[0],-d_dir[1]): continue
            m=(cur[0]+nd[0],cur[1]+nd[1])
            if ok(m[0],m[1]): dfs(m,nd,runs+1,path+[m])
    if avert:
        col=Apt[0][1]
        starts=[(((min(p[0] for p in Apt),col),)),None]
        starts=[([(min(p[0] for p in Apt),col),(1,0)),([(max(p[0] for p in Apt),col),(-1,0)])][::0]] if False else []
        # simpler: explicit list
        starts=[((min(p[0] for p in Apt),col),(1,0)),((max(p[0] for p in Apt),col),(-1,0))]
    else:
        row=Apt[0][0]
        starts=[((row,min(p[1] for p in Apt)),(0,1)),((row,max(p[1] for p in Apt)),(0,-1))]
    for st,d0 in starts: dfs(st,d0,1,[st])
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for (i,j) in (best[1] if best else []): out[i][j]=3
    return out

for n in [3,4,5,6,7,8]:
    k=f'Demo pair {n} input'; act_key=k.replace(' input',' output')
    pred=solve(G[k]); act=G[act_key]
    dif=[(i,j) for i in range(len(pred)) for j in range(len(pred[0])) if pred[i][j]!=act[i][j]]
    print(k,'match:',not dif,'ndiff',len(dif),dif[:5])

def solve(gi):
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    cnt=[x for r in gi for x in r]
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v not in (2,3)),key=lambda v:cnt.count(v)) if False else max(set(cnt)-{2,3},key=lambda v:cnt.count(v))
    def segs(mk): return [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mk]
    A,B=segs(2),segs(3)
    # BFS from A cells to nearest B cell, minimize steps; tie-break: straighter path (fewer turns) then lexicographic
    import heapq
    def score(path):
        turns=sum(1 for k in range(1,len(path)) if (path[k][0]-path[k-1][0])*(path[k-1][0]-path[k-2][0])+... ) 
        return len(path), sum(1 for k in range(2,len(path)) if (path[k][0]-path[k-1][0])* (path[k-1][0]-path[k-2][0])!= (path[k][1]-path[k-1][1])*(path[k-1][1]-path[k-2][1]))
    best=None
    # multi-source BFS with parent tracking using dict of (cell)->(prev,dir)
    dist={a:None for a in A}
    par={}
    Q=deque(a for a in A)
    found=None
    while Q:
        cur=Q.popleft()
        if cur in B:
            found=cur; break
        for nb in [(cur[0]+1,cur[1]),(cur[0]-1,cur[1]),(cur[0],cur[1]+1),(cur[0],cur[1]-1)]:

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(gi):
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v not in (2,3)),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    def pts(mk): return [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mk]
    P2=pts(2); P3=pts(3)
    vertical = len({j for _,j in P2})==1
    best=None
    if vertical:
        col=P2[0][1]
        ends=[(min(p[0] for p in P2),(1,0)),(max(p[0] for p in P2),(-1,0))]
        # candidate paths: straight run along col from endpoint, then perpendicular to nearest row of P3
        for s,dr in ends:
            run=[]; cur=s
            while True:
                n=(cur[0]+dr,cur[1])
                if not (0<=n<H and gi[n][cur[1]]==bg): break
                cur=n; run.append(cur)
            if not run: continue
            for st in run:
                targets=[b for b in P3 if b[1]==col]
                if not targets: continue
                tgt=min(targets,key=lambda b:abs(b[0]-st[0]))
                conn=[]; r=st[0]; step=(1 if tgt[0]>st[0] else -1,0)
                okc=True
                rr=r
                while (rr+step[0],st[1])!=(tgt[0],st[1]):
                    rr+=step[0]
                    if gi[rr][st[1]]!=bg: okc=False; break
                    conn.append((rr,st[1]))
                if okc and 0<=tgt[0]<H:
                    cand=list(run)+conn
                    sc=sum(1 for c in cand if c not in set(P2)|set(P3))
                    if best is None or sc>best[0]: best=(sc,cand)
    else:
        row=P2[0][0]
        ends=[(min(p[1] for p in P2),(0,1)),(max(p[1] for p in P2),(0,-1))]
        for s,dc in ends:
            run=[]; cur=s
            while True:
                n=(cur[0],cur[1]+dc)
                if not (0<=n<W and gi[cur[0]][n]==bg): break
                cur=n; run.append(cur)
            if not run: continue
            for st in run:
                targets=[b for b in P3 if b[0]==row]
                if not targets: continue
                tgt=min(targets,key=lambda b:abs(b[1]-st[1]))
                conn=[]; c=st[1]; step=(1 if tgt[1]>st[1] else -1,0)

                while (st[0],cc+step[1])!=(st[0],tgt[1]):
                    cc+=step[1]
                    if gi[st[0]][cc]!=bg: okc=False; break
                    conn.append((st[0],cc))
                if okc:
                    cand=list(run)+conn
                    sc=sum(1 for c in cand if c not in set(P2)|set(P3))
                    if best is None or sc>best[0]: best=(sc,cand)
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for (i,j) in (best[1] if best else []): out[i][j]=3
    return out

for n in [3,4,5,6,7,8]:

def load():

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

def solve(gi):

    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v not in (2,3)),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    def pts(mk): return [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mk]
    P2=pts(2); P3=pts(3)
    vertical = len({j for _,j in P2})==1
    best=None
    if vertical:
        col=P2[0][1]
        top=min(p[0] for p in P2); bot=max(p[0] for p in P2)
        for s,d in (((top,(1,0))),(bot,(-1,0))):

            cur=s; bestcand=None
            while True:

                nb=(cur[0]+d[0],cur[1])

                # stop testing if further along won't help: just always test

                if tgt[1]==cur[1]: continue  # same column, no connector
                # horizontal path from cur to tgt column
                lo,hi=sorted((cur[1],tgt[1]))
                path=[(c2,cur[1]) for c2 in range(lo+1,hi)]  # cells strictly between columns
                okc=all(gi[c2][cur[1]]==bg for c2 in path)
                # allow last cell (adjacent to B) to be noise? demo3 needs it: allow overwrite at neighbor-of-tgt
                okc|=any(gi[path[-1][0]][cur[1]]!=bg for _ in [0]) if path else False
                sc=len(path)+len([x for x in path if True])
                if okc and (bestcand is None or sc>bestcand[0]): bestcand=(sc,path+[(cur[0],cur[1])])
                cur=nb
            if bestcand and (best is None or bestcand[0]>best[0]): best=bestcand
    else:
        row=P2[0][0]
        left=min(p[1] for p in P2); right=max(p[1] for p in P2)
        for s,d in (((left,(0,1))),(right,(0,-1))):
            cur=s
            while True:
                nb=(cur[0],cur[1]+d[1])
                if not (0<=nb[0]<H and 0<=nb[1]<W and gi[nb[0]][nb[1]]==bg): break
                tgt=min(P3,key=lambda b:(abs(b[0]-cur[0])+abs(b[1]-cur[1])))
                if tgt[0]==cur[0]: continue
                lo,hi=sorted((cur[0],tgt[0]))
                path=[(cur[1],r2) for r2 in range(lo+1,hi)]
                okc=all(gi[cur[1]][r2]==bg for r2 in path)
                if okc and (best is None or len(path)>best[0]): best=len(path),path
                cur=nb
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    if best:
        for (i,j) in best[1]: out[i][j]=3
    return out

def info(n):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; act=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v not in (2,3)),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    def pts(mk): return sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mk)
    A=pts(2); B=pts(3)
    paint=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if act[i][j]==3 and gi[i][j]!=3)
    # blocked cells along each segment's axis beyond its tip
    out={}
    out['bg']=bg; out['A']=A; out['B']=B; out['paint']=sorted(paint)
    # for each A cell, next along axis towards B centroid
    import math
    Bc=(sum(b[0] for b in B)/len(B), sum(b[1] for b in B)/len(B))
    for a in A:
        dr=1 if Bc[0]>a[0] else -1
        dc=1 if Bc[1]>a[1] else -1
        nxt=(a[0]+dr,a[1]+dc)
        out[f'A_next({a})']=nxt
    return out

from collections import deque
def solve_bfs(gi):
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v not in (2,3)),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    def pts(mk): return sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mk)
    P2=pts(2); P3=pts(3)
    A=set(P2); B=set(P3)
    start=min(A); goal=min(B)
    # multi-source BFS from B over bg cells (and A cells) to find shortest path to A
    dist={b:0 for b in B}; par={}
    q=deque(b for b in B)
    while q:
        u=q.popleft()
        for v in ((u[0]+1,u[1]),(u[0]-1,u[1]),(u[0],u[1]+1),(u[0],u[1]-1)):
            if 0<=v[0]<H and 0<=v[1]<W and v not in dist and (gi[v[0]][v[1]]==bg or v in A):
                dist[v]=dist[u]+1; par[v]=u; q.append(v)
    # walk back from A to B
    path=[]; u=start
    while u not in B:
        u=par.get(u); path.append(u)
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for i,j in path: out[i][j]=3
    return out

def solve_path(gi):
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v not in (2,3)),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    def pts(mk): return sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mk)
    P2=pts(2); P3=pts(3)
    A=set(P2); B=set(P3)
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    # candidate: straight from one end of A toward B until blocking, then straight to B's column/row line
    if len({p[1] for p in P2})==1:   # vertical A at col c
        c=P2[0][1]; occ=A|B
        for st,d in [((min(p[0] for p in P2),c),(-1,0)),((max(p[0] for p in P2),c),(1,0))]:
            cur=st; run=[]
            while True:
                n=(cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1])
                if not (0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W) or gi[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg or n in occ: break
                cur=n; run.append(cur)
            # target: nearest B cell reachable horizontally/vertically
            if d==(1,0):
                tgts=[b for b in B if b[1]==c]
                if not tgts: continue
                tgt=min(tgts,key=lambda b:abs(b[0]-cur[0]))
            elif d==(-1,0):
                tgts=[b for b in B if b[1]==c]
                if not tgts: continue
                tgt=min(tgts,key=lambda b:abs(b[0]-cur[0]))
            else:
                continue
            mid=[(r,c) for r in range(cur[0]+d[0],tgt[0])]
            if all(0<=r<H and gi[r][c]==bg for r,c in mid):
                cand=(len(run)+len(mid), run+mid)
    else:  # horizontal A at row r
        r=P2[0][0]; occ=A|B
        for st,d in [((min(p[1] for p in P2),r),(0,-1)),((max(p[1] for p in P2),r),(0,1))]:
            cur=st; run=[]
            while True:
                n=(cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1])
                if not (0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W) or gi[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg or n in occ: break
                cur=n; run.append(cur)
            if d==(0,1):
                tgts=[b for b in B if b[0]==r]
                if not tgts: continue
                tgt=min(tgts,key=lambda b:abs(b[1]-cur[1]))
            elif d==(0,-1):
                tgts=[b for b in B if b[0]==r]
                if not tgts: continue
                tgt=min(tgts,key=lambda b:abs(b[1]-cur[1]))
            mid=[(r,cc) for cc in range(cur[1]+d[1],tgt[1])]
            if all(0<=cc<W and gi[r][cc]==bg for r,cc in mid):
                cand=(len(run)+len(mid), run+mid)
    if 'cand' in dir() and cand:
        _,path=min(cand)
        for i,j in path: out[i][j]=3
    return out
for n in range(3,9):
    k=f'Demo pair {n} input'; ak=k.replace(' input',' output')
    pred=solve_path(G[k]); act=G[ak]
    dif=[(i,j) for i in range(len(pred)) for j in range(len(pred[0])) if pred[i][j]!=act[i][j]]
    print(n,'match:',not dif,'ndiff',len(dif),dif[:6])

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v not in (2,3)),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    def pts(mk): return sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mk)
    P2=pts(2); P3=pts(3)
    def axis(P):
        if len({p[1] for p in P})==1: return (1,0)   # vertical

    a_axis=axis(P2); b_axis=axis(P3)
    ends2={(min(p[0] for p in P2),(0,-1)):None} if False else None
    res=[]
    for e2,d2 in [((min(p[0] for p in P2),P2[0][1]),(-1,0)),
                  ((max(p[0] for p in P2),P2[0][1]),(1,0)),
                  ((min(p[1] for p in P2),P2[0][0]),(0,-1)),
                  ((max(p[1] for p in P2),P2[0][0]),(0,1))]:
        if d2!=a_axis: continue
        e3,d3=[((min(p[0] for p in P3),P3[0][1]),(-1,0)),
               ((max(p[0] for p in P3),P3[0][1]),(1,0)),
               ((min(p[1] for p in P3),P3[0][0]),(0,-1)),
               ((max(p[1] for p in P3),P3[0][0]),(0,1))]
        if d3!=b_axis: continue
        # middle must be perpendicular to a_axis (and parallel to b_axis)
        perp=(-d2[1],d2[0])
        mid_d = (perp[0]*d3[0] + perp[1]*d3[1]) != 0  # not collinear with b_axis... skip check; just require middle straight between endpoints
        lo=min(e2[0],e3[0]); hi=max(e2[0],e3[0])
        # middle goes from e2+d2 end to e3 along perp
        cur=e2[0]+d2[0], e2[1]+d2[1]
        # determine middle direction: from cur toward e3
        dr=(e3[0]-cur[0]); dc=(e3[1]-cur[1])
        md = (dr//max(abs(dr),abs(dc),1), dc//max(abs(dc),abs(dr),1))
        if md!=(perp[0]//abs(perp[0] or 1), perp[1]//abs(perp[1] or 1)) and md!=(perp[0],perp[1]):

        cells=[]
        c=cur
        while c!=e3:
            n=(c[0]+md[0],c[1]+md[1])
            if n==e3: break
            c=n; cells.append(c)
        sc=sum(1 for c in cells if c not in set(P2)|set(P3))
        res.append((sc,cells,e2,d2,e3,d3))
    sc,cells,*_=min(res)
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=3
    return out

def show(i):
    di=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; do_=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']

    for r in range(H):
        line=''
        for c in range(W):
            v=di[r][c]

            elif v==2: line+='T'
            elif v==3: line+='S'
            else: line+='.'
        print(' '+line)

from collections import deque
def f(di):
    H=len(di);W=len(di[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in di for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    two=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if di[r][c]==2]
    three=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if di[r][c]==3]
    def bgc(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and di[r][c]==bg
    starts=[n for r,c in two for n in {(r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)} if bgc(*n)]
    goals=[]
    for r,c in three:
        for n in {(r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)}:
            if bgc(*n): goals.append(n)
    if not starts or not goals: return [row[:] for row in di]
    start=starts; seen=set(starts)
    parent={}
    q=deque(start); hit=None
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        if (r,c) in goals and (r,c) not in starts: hit=(r,c); break
        for nr,nc in {(r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)}:

    out=[row[:] for row in di]

    while cur:

def analyze(i):
    di=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; do_=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    H=len(di);W=len(di[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in di for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    T=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if di[r][c]==2]
    S=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if di[r][c]==3]
    chg={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if di[r][c]!=do_[r][c]}
    # bridge column: vertical run column(s)
    vcols=sorted({c for r,c in chg if len({rr for rr,cc in chg if rr==r and cc==c})==len(chg)})
    # actually vertical run = column with >1 changed cell in consecutive rows
    vert=[]
    for c in range(W):
        col=[r for r in range(H) if (r,c) in chg]
        if len(col)>1 and all(col[k+1]-col[k]==1 for k in range(len(col)-1)): vert.append(c)
    return di,do_,T,S,bg,vert,chg
res={}
for i in range(1,9):
    res[i]=analyze(i)
for i in [1,5,7]:
    di,do_,T,S,bg,vert,chg=res[i]
    print('demo',i,'T',T,'S',S,'bridge col(s)',vert)
    # clearance: min manhattan dist from path cells to nearest non-bg non-anom cell
    others=[(r,c) for r in range(len(di)) for c in range(len(di[0])) if di[r][c] not in (bg,2,3)]
    def mind(pt):
        best=99
        for o in others:
            best=min(best,abs(pt[0]-o[0])+abs(pt[1]-o[1]))
        return best
    for col in vert:
        cells=[(r,col) for r in range(min(T[0][0],S[0][0]),max(T[0][0],S[0][0])+1)]
        # path = row_T from T toward col, col down/up, row_S from col to S
        tr=T[0][0]; sr=S[0][0]
        path=[]
        tc=T[0][1] if T[0][1]>col else T[1][1]
        sc=S[0][1] if S[0][1]<col else S[1][1]
        path+= [(tr,c) for c in range(tc+ (1 if col>tc else -1), col+(1 if col>tc else -1))]
        path+=[(r,col) for r in range(min(tr,sr),max(tr,sr)+1)]
        path+=[(sr,c) for c in range(col+(1 if col<sc else -1), sc+(1 if col<sc else -1))]
        print('  col',col,'clearance',min(mind(p) for p in path))
